objective: For G = H(F_q) x| C_r with the generator acting by (x, y, z) -> (a x, b y, a b z), r | q - 1, p not dividing r: on a closed 3-manifold, the maps over each character are |Z^1| |B^1|^2 times the number of pairs (u, v) in V_a x V_b whose cup product vanishes, which by duality is the kernel count of a trilinear form on V_a x V_b x V_g with g = (ab)^-1; Y-surgery with leaves in ker psi lifted to the r-fold cover (constant r, invertible mod p) adds sum over permutations sgn l x m x n of leaf functionals. Check the count against brute force and the steering law for odd p.
status: Proved by COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001B-P001: for G = H(F_q) x| C_r acting by (a x, b y, a b z), the maps over a character number |Z^1| |B^1|^2 times the kernel count of the eigen-triple form T on V_a x V_b x V_g (g = (ab)^-1) by duality; Y-surgery with leaves in ker psi keeps H1 and changes every eigen-component by the signed sum of leaf functionals (Massuyeau's lemma lifted to the r-fold cover, the factor r cancelling), the finite-cover analogue of Moussard's rational formula; over prime fields pure leaves make every form of the allowed symmetry type realizable. Checked against brute force in twelve cases and in all four coincidence patterns.
title: Heisenberg counting splits into eigen-triple forms that Borromean moves steer
